bundle.shortDescription: CorpusMind Lens — vision-LM-powered multimodal discourse analysis.
bundle.longDescription: CorpusMind Lens is a separate installable desktop app that connects to the same CorpusMind engine. It focuses on vision-LM-powered image understanding: image-set management, visual discourse analysis, image-text alignment, and batch analysis across image sets — all running against a local Ollama or LM Studio instance with zero cloud calls.
